food.name: Figlmüller Wollzeile
food.blurb: Plate-sized Wiener schnitzel, pounded thin, served since 1905. Book a table; the queue is real.

food.name: Dom Schnitzel
food.blurb: Classic Wiener schnitzel a few steps from Stephansdom.

food.name: Ramen Makotoya
food.blurb: Ramen by the Rathaus, with more branches in Neubau and Landstraße.

food.name: Lola
food.q: Lola Spanisches Tapas Restaurant, Gonzagagasse 14, Wien
food.blurb: Spanish tapas in the old town. Order a lot of small plates and share.

cafe.name: Café Sperl
cafe.blurb: Billiard tables, marble tops, newspapers on sticks. Order a Melange and an apple strudel and stay an hour.

sights.name: Schönbrunn Palace
sights.blurb: The Habsburg summer palace. Climb to the Gloriette for the view.

sights.name: Stephansdom
sights.blurb: The cathedral at the center of everything. 343 steps up the south tower.

sights.name: Prunksaal, National Library
sights.blurb: The baroque State Hall of the Austrian National Library: frescoed dome, 200,000 old books, and one of the most beautiful rooms in Europe.

sights.name: Belvedere Palace
sights.blurb: Two baroque palaces facing each other across terraced gardens. Klimt's The Kiss hangs in the Upper Belvedere.

trips.name: Wachau Valley
trips.blurb: Terraced vineyards and apricot orchards along the Danube. Bike from Krems to Dürnstein and climb to the castle ruin.

trips.name: Kahlenberg & Vienna Woods
trips.blurb: Hike the vineyard trails above the city and finish with a view over all of Vienna.

trips.name: Lednice–Valtice
trips.time: 1 h by train to Břeclav + 15 min bus
trips.blurb: A UNESCO landscape of palaces, follies and a minaret in the middle of Moravian wine country.

trips.name: Hallstatt & Salzkammergut
trips.time: Full-day guided tour, about 3.5 h each way
trips.blurb: The lakeside village in the Alps that looks like a postcard, plus the mountains and lakes of the Salzkammergut on the way.

food.name: Lokál Dlouhááá
food.blurb: Svíčková, fried cheese and the best-kept Pilsner Urquell in town, poured straight from the tank.

food.name: U Tří jelínků
food.blurb: A traditional Czech restaurant on Nerudova, the steep lane up to the castle. Easy stop on the way up or down.

food.name: Oishi Praha
food.blurb: Sushi and Japanese dishes in the center, with branches on Spálená and V Celnici.

food.name: Lore Malastrana
food.blurb: Homemade Italian cooking from Chef Lore, on a quiet lane below the castle in Malá Strana.

food.name: Pho Vietnam Tuan & Lan
food.blurb: A local favorite for steaming bowls of pho, a short walk from Vinohrady.

cafe.name: Café Savoy
cafe.blurb: Painted Neo-Renaissance ceiling, a pastry case worth the walk, and a great breakfast before the castle.

sights.name: Charles Bridge
sights.blurb: Go at sunrise before the crowds. It's empty, and the light is perfect.

sights.name: Prague Castle
sights.blurb: The largest ancient castle complex in the world, plus St. Vitus Cathedral.

sights.name: Old Town Square
sights.blurb: The Astronomical Clock strikes the hour. Watch it once.

sights.name: Letná Beer Garden
sights.blurb: Cheap beer under chestnut trees with the whole city below you. Best at sunset.

trips.name: Karlštejn Castle
trips.blurb: A Gothic castle on a wooded hill, built to guard Charles IV's crown jewels. Walk up from the village.

trips.name: Kutná Hora
trips.blurb: An old silver-mining town with a soaring cathedral and the famous bone chapel at Sedlec.

trips.name: Bohemian Switzerland
trips.blurb: Sandstone towers and gorges. Hike to Pravčická brána, Europe's largest natural rock arch, and take a boat through the Kamenice gorge.

food.name: Augustiner-Keller
food.blurb: 5,000 seats under chestnut trees, beer from wooden barrels, half a roast chicken. A late-summer must.

food.name: Wirtshaus in der Au
food.q: Wirtshaus in der Au, Lilienstraße 51, München
food.blurb: A Bavarian tavern known for its dumplings. They also run dumpling cooking classes.

food.name: Meraki
food.blurb: Greek cooking in Haidhausen, across the Isar from the old town.

food.name: Indian Village
food.blurb: Indian cooking out in Fasanerie, in the north of the city. Best paired with a trip out that way.

cafe.name: Café Frischhut
cafe.blurb: One thing on the menu: fried dough, hot from the pan, next to the Viktualienmarkt. Opens early.

sights.name: Marienplatz & Viktualienmarkt
sights.blurb: The Glockenspiel at 11, then graze the market stalls.

sights.name: Nymphenburg Palace
sights.blurb: Baroque palace with huge gardens. Rent a gondola on the canal.

sights.name: Asamkirche
sights.blurb: A tiny late-baroque church packed floor to ceiling with gold, stucco and frescoes, squeezed between townhouses on Sendlinger Straße.

trips.name: Lake Starnberg
trips.blurb: Swim, paddle or ride a steamer across a lake with the Alps on the horizon.

trips.name: Neuschwanstein
trips.blurb: The fairy-tale castle above the Alpsee. Book timed tickets well ahead.

trips.name: Partnach Gorge
trips.blurb: A roaring gorge cut into the limestone, with the Zugspitze above it.

trips.name: Salzburg
trips.time: 1 h 30 by train, or stop on the way back to Vienna
trips.blurb: Mozart's baroque hometown under a clifftop fortress, right across the Austrian border.

sights.name: Lednice Chateau
sights.blurb: A neo-Gothic palace with a huge glasshouse and an English park you can explore by boat.

sights.name: The Minaret
sights.blurb: A 60 m minaret folly in the park. Climb it for views across the whole estate.

sights.name: Valtice Chateau & wine salon
sights.blurb: Baroque palace whose cellars hold the National Wine Salon: taste the best 100 Czech wines.

sights.name: Colonnade on Reistna
sights.blurb: A hilltop colonnade above Valtice with views over the vineyards toward Austria.

sights.name: Getreidegasse & Mozart's birthplace
sights.blurb: The old-town shopping street with wrought-iron signs, and the yellow house where Mozart was born.

sights.name: Hohensalzburg Fortress
sights.blurb: One of Europe's largest medieval castles. Take the funicular up for the view.

sights.name: Mirabell Gardens
sights.blurb: Formal baroque gardens with the fortress framed behind the fountains.

sights.name: Augustiner Bräu Mülln
sights.blurb: A monastery brewery with a huge chestnut-shaded beer garden. Beer poured from wooden barrels into stone mugs.

sights.name: Neuschwanstein Castle
sights.blurb: King Ludwig II's fairy-tale castle on a crag above the gorge. Inside visits are by timed ticket only.

sights.name: Marienbrücke
sights.blurb: The iron footbridge over the Pöllat gorge with the classic postcard view of the castle.

sights.name: Hohenschwangau Castle
sights.blurb: The yellow castle where Ludwig grew up, on the hill facing Neuschwanstein.

sights.name: Alpsee
sights.blurb: A clear mountain lake right below the castles. Rent a rowboat or swim from the beach.

sights.name: Dürnstein Abbey
sights.blurb: The blue-and-white baroque tower on the riverbank, the postcard of the whole valley.

sights.name: Kuenringer Castle ruin
sights.blurb: A short steep climb to the ruin where Richard the Lionheart was held, with the best view of the Danube.

sights.name: Weißenkirchen
sights.blurb: A wine village of fortified churches and Heurigen, surrounded by terraced Riesling vineyards.

sights.name: Krems old town
sights.blurb: The gateway town of the valley: rent bikes here, then ride the river path to Dürnstein.

sights.name: Kahlenberg viewpoint
sights.blurb: The terrace above the vineyards with all of Vienna and the Danube laid out below.

sights.name: Leopoldsberg
sights.blurb: The neighbouring hilltop with a small castle church and an even steeper drop to the river.

sights.name: Kahlenbergerdorf
sights.blurb: A tiny wine village at the foot of the hill. The Nussberg trail runs from here through the vineyards.

sights.name: Grinzing
sights.blurb: The classic Heuriger village. Walk down here and end the hike with wine in a garden.

sights.name: Marktplatz
sights.blurb: The tiny market square of painted houses between the lake and the mountain.

sights.name: Skywalk World Heritage View
sights.blurb: A platform hanging off the cliff 350 m above the village. Take the funicular up.

sights.name: Salt mine
sights.blurb: The world's oldest salt mine, with miners' slides between levels.

sights.name: Bone House
sights.blurb: A chapel of painted skulls, a local tradition from when the churchyard ran out of space.

sights.name: Karlštejn Castle
sights.blurb: Charles IV's treasure castle. Book the tour of the Great Tower to see the gilded chapel.

sights.name: Karlštejn village
sights.blurb: The walk up from the station through the village is half the fun, past cafés and a wax museum.

sights.name: Velká Amerika quarry
sights.blurb: A flooded limestone quarry nicknamed the Czech Grand Canyon, an hour's hike from the castle.

sights.name: Sedlec Ossuary
sights.blurb: A chapel decorated with the bones of some 40,000 people, including a bone chandelier.

sights.name: St. Barbara's Church
sights.blurb: A soaring Gothic cathedral built by the silver miners, with tent-like roofs.

sights.name: Italian Court
sights.blurb: The old royal mint where the silver Prague groschen was struck.

sights.name: Sedlec Cathedral
sights.q: Katedrála Nanebevzetí Panny Marie a sv. Jana Křtitele
sights.blurb: A bright Gothic-baroque cathedral next to the ossuary, often skipped and well worth it.

sights.name: Pravčická brána
sights.blurb: Europe's largest natural sandstone arch, a steady 1.5 h hike from Hřensko.

sights.name: Edmund's Gorge boats
sights.blurb: Wooden boats poled through a narrow gorge by boatmen who tell jokes in Czech.

sights.name: Hřensko
sights.blurb: The village squeezed into the canyon where the Kamenice meets the Elbe. Start here.

sights.name: Mezní Louka
sights.blurb: The trail junction on the ridge between the arch and the gorges, with a lodge for lunch.

sights.name: Starnberg lakefront
sights.blurb: Step off the S-Bahn onto the promenade. Boats leave from here for the round-the-lake trip.

sights.name: Roseninsel
sights.blurb: King Ludwig's little island hideaway with a rose garden, reached by a tiny ferry.

sights.name: Possenhofen Castle
sights.blurb: Empress Sisi's childhood summer home, next to a lakeside park and swimming spot.

sights.name: Votive Chapel, Berg
sights.blurb: A chapel on the shore where King Ludwig II drowned, with a cross standing in the water.

sights.name: Partnach Gorge
sights.blurb: The trail runs through tunnels cut into the rock beside the roaring water.

sights.name: Olympic Ski Stadium
sights.blurb: The giant ski jump at the trailhead, home of the New Year's jump.

sights.name: Eckbauer cable car
sights.blurb: Ride up and walk down to the gorge for a gentler loop with Alpine views.

sights.name: Ludwigstraße, Partenkirchen
sights.blurb: A street of painted Bavarian houses and beer halls for after the hike.
